Long English stretches 28:31-29:51, 33:00-36:55, 56:00-1:01:39. Names: كانو = Kano not present as a word in this transcript (كانو at 42:33 is kaanu 'they were').

No echo-candidates file existed for this date. Name check: كانوا in this lesson is the verb 'were', not Kano. Left out on purpose: 'last kind' vs 'last one' (17:52-18:21, Amal says both fine); 40:00 قرأت (Amal repeated it, he said it right); تانية vs تانين (46:48-47:39, Amal says تانية is valid); 'costume' (not on her sheet, so not tier 3); 49:15-49:51 إشي المفضل عندي (Amal said صح). 30:20 and 44:17 may be his own self-fixes (low confidence). Several fixes are Amal's English prompts (13:44, 24:15, 30:22, 42:31).

agreed.medi_said: و الـ-- وال بنات الـ-- بنات و-- أو ولاد، ... أمها أو أبوها.
agreed.amal_said: أوه، عمها وعمتها. Cuz ولاد أمها are أخوتها.
agreed.why: He described aunts/uncles as 'children of her mother or father' (= her siblings); Amal supplied عمها وعمتها (sheet: 'aunt (paternal) | 3ammeh', 'uncle (paternal) | 3am').

agreed.medi_said: bifikru el lugha muhim ilhom.
agreed.why: لغة is feminine so the adjective is muhimme; Amal 'بس لغة as well', he: 'Oh, it's feminine. ... muhema'.
agreed.english: They think the language is important for them.

agreed.medi_said: Ma libisna. ... Shwe min kbar, libisna costume bas kul il zgar.
agreed.why: Subject is el-kbaar (they) so the verb is libsu, not libisna (we); Amal recast لبسوا, he: 'It would be لبسوا?'.
agreed.english: The adults didn't dress up / some adults dressed up.

agreed.medi_said: Okay. Uh, libsa Halloween. Libsa, right?
agreed.why: Feminine first word of an idafa takes -t: libset Halloween; he repeats Libsit and explains it.

agreed.medi_said: كل حدا، آآ، جابوا
agreed.amal_said: صح. بس now I'm describing one. So jab أو jabu. ... Cos I'm saying person.
agreed.why: kul 7ada (each person) is singular so the verb is jaab; he: 'Oh, you're right. جاب.'

agreed.medi_said: واحد أكلة.
agreed.amal_said: آ، واحدة is an adjective. So what do where do I put it؟
agreed.why: The number-adjective follows the noun and agrees: akle wa7de; Amal asked where it goes and he said أكلة واحدة.

agreed.medi_said: طلبوا مني، آآ، إنه جبت kebab.
agreed.why: After talabu minni enno (asked me to) the second verb is the bare present ajeeb, not past jibt; Amal 'إنه to bring', then أجيب.
agreed.english: They asked me to bring kebab.

agreed.medi_said: Oh God, what was spinach? ... شو الكلمة spinach؟
agreed.why: He asked the word; Amal supplied it (sheet: 'spinach | sabane5 | سبانخ'); he: 'That's right.'

agreed.medi_said: بيضة. / مثل بيضة like eggs and cheese, right؟
agreed.amal_said: لا، لا. It's a type of cheese. جبنة بيضا. / لا، يعني white cheese.
agreed.why: He took her جبنة بيضا (white cheese) for egg and repeated بيضة twice; Amal said no, white cheese. Listening miss.

agreed.medi_said: يوم الثلاث،
agreed.why: Asked what day it is he named the wrong day; Amal said No and he gave يوم الاثنين (sheet: monday).

agreed.medi_said: أنا بأسب منهم. ... أنا بأسب لهم
agreed.amal_said: Mm-mm. I got upset for them. ... Mm-hmm. I got.
agreed.why: The prompt was 'I got upset' (past); he used the present b- form; Amal 'I got' and he: 'Oh, you're right' then the past form.

agreed.medi_said: Alayhom ala...
agreed.why: He tried to add a preposition before 'the end of the movie'; Amal said no, you don't need anything.
agreed.english: at the end of the movie

agreed.medi_said: akher. No, tahet.
agreed.amal_said: Mm-hmm. La saħħ. ... Shu yammi taħet. [laughs] It's not taħet.
agreed.why: He swapped akher (end) for ta7t (under); Amal: 'It's not taħet'.

agreed.medi_said: أنا جاوبت على أغلب من-- أغلب الـ، أغلب السؤال، ... أسئلة،
agreed.why: a8lab takes a definite noun directly (a8lab el-as2ile), not min; Medi at 28:43: 'I said أغلب من and you corrected me'. Singular السؤال -> أسئلة was his own fix in the same turn.
agreed.english: I answered most of the questions.

agreed.medi_said: من الـ آخر. ... آخر هي هو؟ ... Is it آخره؟
agreed.amal_said: The end of it. ... Just it. ... صح، آخره.
agreed.why: 'The end of it' is aa5er + pronoun ending (aa5ro); Amal prompted 'The end of it' / 'Just it' until he said آخره.
agreed.english: Worse than the end of it.

agreed.medi_said: No، طلب-- غير تاني. No، إشي غير من هم.
agreed.why: 8eir goes before the noun; Amal recast غير إشي and he said 'غير always comes before the noun'.
agreed.english: I asked them for something else.

agreed.medi_said: Would it be مواسف here or would it be ياسر؟
agreed.why: He asked which word means 'angering'; مواسف (m3asseb = angry, per Amal 39:17 'ماسب is angry، بس angering') is the wrong one, she gave بيعصب.

agreed.medi_said: بالـ، بالصباح أو، uh, كان angering.
agreed.amal_said: بيعصب بس كان أو كانوا cuz أخبار is multiple news.
agreed.why: أخبار is plural so the verb is kaanu; Amal named it ('أخبار is plural').

agreed.medi_said: أو بيعصبوا.
agreed.why: Past description needs kaanu; Amal 'they were' and he said كانو بيعصبوا.

agreed.medi_said: الحرب راح, راح يسير أسوأ.
agreed.why: حرب is feminine so ra7 tSeer; after Amal's prompt he said 'راح تصير أسوأ' and she said صح.
agreed.english: The war is going to get worse.

agreed.medi_said: لما أنا أطلع الطبيعة
agreed.why: Look at takes 3ala; Amal 'أطلع at.' and he said أتطلع على الطبيعة.

agreed.medi_said: No, your صحابك تانيين.
agreed.why: صحابك is definite (pronoun ending) so the adjective takes el-: التانيين; Amal 'close... التاني' and explained 'صحابك is definitive'.

agreed.medi_said: عائلتي, my other family, it would be التاني.
agreed.why: عائلة is feminine, so التانية; Amal recast.

agreed.medi_said: هذي أول مرة أول يومي هون.
agreed.why: يوم is masculine so hada; Amal recast هذا.
agreed.english: This is my first day here.

agreed.medi_said: هذي أول مرة أول يومي هون. ... هذي أول اليومي هون.
agreed.amal_said: أول يومي is what? ... No. What does أول يومي mean? ... صح.
agreed.why: awal + possessed noun means 'the beginning of my day'; for 'my first day' use يومي الأول or أول يوم إلي; Amal prompted until يومي الأول.
agreed.english: This is my first day here.

agreed.medi_said: يوم الأول.
agreed.why: An adjective with el- needs a definite noun (yoomi el-awal); Amal prompted and he said يومي الأول.

r1.medi_said: So الواجب عندو تلات سو-- أسول-- أو-- Hold on. أسئلة.

r2.medi_said: الواجب عندو تلات سو-- أسول-- أو-- Hold on. أسئلة.

r1.amal_said: Mm-mm. Happy with me. ... Happy from, from something I did. ... so minni.
r1.why: inbasat takes min (happy from someone), not ma3i; Amal 'Mm-mm', then 'minni', and 'I heard my' confirms he said ma3i.

r1.why: Object ending: they ordered IT (the kebab), not me; Amal recast طلبوه twice and said 'No. They requested.'
